Every step names the wiki pages it comes from in src (page titles under data/raw/wiki/ref or data/raw/wiki/pages, or data:<group> for the pulled card data). build.py fails if a number in a step is not in its sources, if a [[name]] is neither a card nor in the sources, or if a capitalised word outside [[ ]] is not in the sources (UI labels in ui_words are allowed).

sections.title: How to come back after a break
sections.need: Your save, the game updated, and some time before you pick up a job.

steps.t: Update the game to [[Update 2.5]]: it came out on October 22, 2026 on PC, Mac (not yet on the Mac App Store), PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
If your save is from before [[Patch 2.0]], spend your perk points again in the **Character** menu: that patch refunded every spent perk point and lets you reset your attributes once.
Pick one build on the **Builds** page.
In the **Character** menu, buy the first three perks of that build: a perk unlocks when its attribute reaches the perk's level (4, 9, 15 or 20).
At a [[Ripperdoc]], fill every empty cyberware slot your capacity allows: you start with 24 capacity at level 1, increasing by 3 each time you level up.
Collect the 14 [[Perk Shard]] pickups listed on the **Missables** page (each gives 1 perk point; one of them is bought at the Black Market in the stadium).
If you own [[Phantom Liberty]] and have not started it, follow **How to start Phantom Liberty**.

steps.h: For Clampdown, a new side job in [[Update 2.5]]:

steps.t: Finish [[The Heist]].
Finish two gigs for Wakako.
Wait for her message: it starts [[Clampdown]].

steps.h: For Welcome to Paradise, the other new side job in Update 2.5:

steps.t: After [[The Heist]], reach Street Cred 15: the job unlocks.

sections.check: The **Character** menu shows no unspent perk points and the ripperdoc screen shows your capacity almost full.

sections.title: How to spend attribute points
sections.need: A new character, or unspent attribute points.

steps.t: At character creation, put your 7 free points into the attribute your build needs most: each attribute is given 3 points by default and can go up to 6 during creation.
After creation, raise attributes up to 20: you get one attribute point and one perk point on each level up.
Raise your build's main attribute first, to the level of the next perk you want (4, 9, 15 or 20).

Treat attribute points as permanent: since [[Patch 2.0]] you can refund each perk on its own for free, but attribute points stay where you put them (old saves got one attribute reset with that patch).

If you have spare points, choose the attribute whose per-point bonus you want: Body +2 Health, Reflexes +0.5% Crit Chance, Technical Ability +2 Armor, Intelligence +1 RAM per 4 points, Cool +1.25% Crit Damage.
Plan for the level cap: 50 in the base game, 60 with [[Phantom Liberty]].

sections.check: Your main attribute reaches the level of the highest perk your build needs.

sections.title: How to buy perks in the right order
sections.need: Unspent perk points and a build from the **Builds** page.

steps.t: In the **Character** menu, select the attribute tree of your build's next perk.
If the perk is greyed out, raise that attribute to the perk's level first (4, 9, 15 or 20; shown on each perk card).
Buy the perk listed under **Needs** on the perk card before the perk itself.
Buy the perks in the order the build lists them; each perk is listed after the perk it needs.
Level your skills to earn extra perk points: each of the five skills gives bonus Perk points at levels 15 and 35.
If you change build, refund perks one at a time in the **Character** menu: since [[Patch 2.0]] each refund is free.

sections.check: Every perk in your build shows as bought and no perk point is left over.

sections.title: How to level the five skills
sections.need: Nothing; skills level from what you do.

steps.t: To level Headhunter (Cool), neutralize enemies with Pistols, Revolvers, Sniper Rifles and throwable weapons, attack while undetected, and do Takedowns.
To level Netrunner (Intelligence), quickhack enemies, devices and vehicles, upload daemons to Access Points, and kill with Smart weapons or Monowire.
steps.n: You upload daemons with a Breach Protocol; the [[Eye In The Sky]] perk highlights nearby Access Points.

steps.t: To level Shinobi (Reflexes), neutralize enemies with Assault Rifles, SMGs and Blades, and dash, dodge, vault and climb.
To level Solo (Body), neutralize enemies with Shotguns, LMGs, HMGs and Blunt Weapons, and pass Body Attribute checks.
To level Engineer (Technical Ability), neutralize enemies with Tech weapons, grenades and Bolt shots, and craft, upgrade and disassemble items.
steps.n: Bolt shots are a Tech weapon ability that you unlock in the perk tree.

steps.t: Check the skill tables on the **Reference** page: skills unlock new passive buffs every 5 levels and can be leveled up to a max of 60.

sections.check: Each skill you use reaches the levels that give bonus Perk points (15 and 35), and you have spent those points.

sections.title: How to raise your cyberware capacity
sections.need: Access to a ripperdoc. Capacity limits how much cyberware you can install.

steps.t: Level up: each level adds 3 capacity, up to a base of 201 at level 60.
Loot every [[Cyberware Capacity Shard]] enemies drop; each tier needs a minimum level (level 2, 9, 17 or 25 or higher, from Tier 2 to Tier 5).
Finish the [[Psycho Killer]] gig for its reward cache: it holds a Tier 4 or Tier 5 variant of the shard.
In [[Dog Eat Dog]], open the cache in the parking garage of the stadium before you leave: that shard is missable.
Level the Engineer skill to 10 (+5 capacity) and to 30 (+10 capacity), +15 in total.
Buy [[Renaissance Punk]]: +4 Cyberware Capacity for each attribute at 9 or higher.
steps.n: That is the perk card's wording. The wiki's Cyberware page says +4 for each attribute over 9, max +20; so the two pages disagree on the lowest attribute level that counts.

steps.t: At Technical Ability 20, buy [[Edgerunner]] (+50).
If you still need room, install the [[Chrome Compressor]] operating system (+70).

sections.check: Capacity is capped at 450; the most you can reach is 430 with the Chrome Compressor installed, or 360 without it.

sections.title: How to fill every cyberware slot

steps.t: At a ripperdoc, fill the base slots: Frontal Cortex 3, Operating System 1, Arms 1, Face 1, Skeleton 2, Hands 1, Nervous System 3, Circulatory System 3, Integumentary System 3, Legs 1.
Buy [[License To Chrome]] to unlock a third Skeleton slot.
Buy [[Ambidextrous]] to unlock a second Hands slot.
If you play [[Phantom Liberty]], finish [[Birds with Broken Wings]] to unlock a second Face slot.
Install at least one implant in all 10 slot types to unlock the Full Body Conversion achievement.

sections.check: No slot on the ripperdoc screen is empty.

paras.t: Armor comes mostly from cyberware. Every 10 points of Armor cut incoming damage per second by about 1 point. You can hold up to 2000 Armor, but the reduction stops growing at 1500 Armor, which gives 50% damage reduction.
A Critical Hit deals 50% more damage, plus your Crit Damage bonus. A headshot adds 100% damage by default.

Out of combat, Health refills on its own up to 60% of the maximum. Food gives Nourishment, which doubles that regeneration; drinks give Hydration, which speeds up Stamina regeneration. The [[Painkiller]] perk lets Health regenerate in combat.
Mitigation is a chance to take less damage from a hit. By default the chance is 0%; a mitigated hit is reduced by your Mitigation Strength, 50% by default.

sections.title: How to start Phantom Liberty

steps.t: If you start a new game and only want the expansion story, choose **Skip ahead to Phantom Liberty**: the game completes the earlier main story jobs (such as [[The Heist]]) for you.

On an existing save, finish these main jobs: [[The Heist]], [[Playing for Time]], [[Automatic Love]], [[The Space in Between]], [[Disasterpiece]], [[Double Life]], [[M'ap Tann Pèlen]], [[I Walk the Line]], [[Transmission]] and [[Never Fade Away (quest)]].
Wait for Songbird to call you; the job [[Phantom Liberty (quest)]] then leads into [[Dog Eat Dog]].
In [[Dog Eat Dog]], take the Perk Shard, the BARGHEST helmet and the Cyberware Capacity Shard before you leave the stadium: all three are missable.

sections.check: The journal shows [[Dog Eat Dog]] as active and you can enter [[Dogtown]].

sections.title: How to unlock the Relic perk tree

steps.t: Play [[Dog Eat Dog]] until Songbird gives you the new Militech combat software: the Relic tree unlocks. Songbird gives you the first 3 points when she first contacts you.
Play on to [[Birds with Broken Wings]], where Songbird gives you 3 more points.
Find the nine Operational Data Terminals in [[Dogtown]] (listed on the **Reference** page) for the remaining nine points.
Spend the 15 points on the Relic perks your build uses (the Relic perk cards say which cyberware each one improves).

sections.check: You have gathered all 15 Relic Points.

sections.title: How to raise Street Cred and buy cars

steps.t: Do gigs from fixers and other jobs to raise [[Street Cred]] (the maximum level is 50).
Check your vendor discount: Street Cred discounts add up to a total of 15% at all vendors, in steps from level 5 to level 50.
Open the [[AUTOFIXER]] netpage on any computer terminal to buy vehicles; higher Street Cred unlocks better cars there.
If you own [[Phantom Liberty]], do the repeatable side job Just Another Story (steal and deliver a marked car) for an AUTOFIXER discount shard.
Look on the **Vehicles** page for cars you can get for free from quests instead of buying them.

sections.check: The car shows in your garage list when you call a vehicle.

sections.title: How to get and keep iconic weapons
sections.need: Nothing; most iconics come from quests and the open world.

steps.t: On the **Weapons** page, tick **Iconic only**.
On each card, read **How to get it**: most iconic weapons can only be obtained once from a single source.
Pick up iconics that a main job gives before you finish that job: the **Missables** page lists them, and its Note says which ones Phantom Liberty lets you buy later from Herold Lowe.
Upgrade iconics instead of replacing them: crafting components upgrade cyberware and iconic weapons to a higher tier.
Keep picking up iconics: acquiring an iconic weapon unlocks the crafting spec for its next quality, up to Legendary.

sections.check: The iconic shows a higher tier after the upgrade at the crafting screen.

sections.title: How to finish the story without losing anything
sections.need: All the side jobs you care about done or in your journal.

steps.t: Finish the side jobs you want before [[Nocturne Op55N1]]: once you take the elevator into Embers (the restaurant where you meet Hanako), every other job in the journal is marked as failed.
Start [[Nocturne Op55N1]]: the game makes a Point of No Return save on its own.
Play any ending; after the epilogue the game returns you to the Point of No Return save.
Check your inventory: ending rewards such as the [[Access Token]] are added to that save.
Load the Point of No Return save again to play another ending.

sections.check: After the credits you are back on the rooftop save with the ending's rewards in your inventory.

sections.title: How to get The Devil ending (Arasaka)
sections.need: Takemura must survive [[Search and Destroy]] for the achievement.

steps.t: In [[Search and Destroy]], after the floor collapses, do not leave the building: Takemura is missing, and you can still go back and save him.
From the room you wake up in, jump up several floors to reach Takemura (needed for The Devil achievement).
On the rooftop in [[Nocturne Op55N1]], call Hanako for help.
Take the omega-blockers (pills).
Play [[Last Caress]].
Play [[Totalimmortal]].
Finish [[Where is My Mind?]].
Choose "[Sign Contract] I want to live" (V becomes an engram) or "[Refuse to Sign] I'm going back to Earth".

sections.check: The Devil achievement unlocks after the credits. If Takemura died, Anders Hellman makes the offer instead and the achievement does not unlock.

sections.title: How to get The Star ending (Aldecaldos)

steps.t: Complete Panam's side job [[Queen of the Highway]].
On the rooftop in [[Nocturne Op55N1]], call Panam for help.
Take the omega-blockers (pills).
Play [[We Gotta Live Together]].
Play [[Forward to Death]].
Play [[Belly of the Beast]].
Play [[Changes]].
Inside Mikoshi, you play as V: enter the well, so V goes back to their own body (Johnny keeping the body is Temperance).
Finish [[All Along the Watchtower]].

sections.check: The Star achievement unlocks: V leaves Night City with the Aldecaldos.

sections.title: How to get The Sun ending (Afterlife legend)

steps.t: At the end of [[Chippin' In (quest)]], answer "A hard road, but looks like we made it."
Then answer "Johnny, no need to bare your soul to me."
steps.n: Other answers lead to Holdin' On instead of Blistering Love; the secret-ending lines also work.

steps.t: Complete Rogue's side job [[Blistering Love]], which Johnny gives you after Chippin' In.
On the rooftop in [[Nocturne Op55N1]], follow Johnny's plan to go ask Rogue for help.
Take the pseudoendotrizine (pills).
Play [[For Whom the Bell Tolls]].
Play [[Knockin' on Heaven's Door]].
Play [[Changes]].
Inside Mikoshi, you play as Johnny: cross the bridge, so Johnny leaves and V keeps the body.
Finish [[Path of Glory]].

sections.check: The Sun achievement unlocks: V becomes a legend of the Afterlife.

sections.title: How to get the Temperance ending (Johnny keeps the body)
sections.need: Panam's or Rogue's path unlocked (see The Star or The Sun).

steps.t: Unlock Panam's or Rogue's path: complete Panam's [[Queen of the Highway]] or Rogue's [[Blistering Love]] side job.
On the rooftop in [[Nocturne Op55N1]], ask Panam or Rogue for help.
Inside Mikoshi, let Johnny keep your body: cross the bridge as V, or enter the well as Johnny.
Finish [[New Dawn Fades]].

sections.check: The Temperance achievement unlocks: Johnny Silverhand keeps V's body.

sections.title: How to get the secret ending (Don't Fear the Reaper)
sections.need: A save before the talk with Johnny at the Northern Oil Fields at the end of Chippin' In. If V dies during the run, the game ends.

steps.t: At the end of [[Chippin' In (quest)]], when Johnny says "But I've managed one thing for now. Not to fuck this up, what we have.", answer "Nah, fucked that up too."
When Johnny says "Ahem. Is it too late to ask for a second chance?", answer "What do you want from me?"
When Johnny says "At least, so it seemed... till now.", answer "Ok. But as second chances go, this is your last."
Start [[Nocturne Op55N1]].
On Misty's rooftop, talk to Johnny.
Do not pick anyone to call: wait about five minutes until Johnny offers one more option.
Accept it to start [[(Don't Fear) The Reaper]], an assault on Arasaka Tower with Johnny alone.
Survive the assault: if V dies at any point, the credits roll and the game is over.
Upload Alt.
Connect to Mikoshi.

steps.h: For The Sun (V keeps the body):

steps.t: Inside Mikoshi, enter the well as V.
Finish [[Path of Glory]].
Inside Mikoshi, cross the bridge as V.
Finish [[New Dawn Fades]].

sections.check: The credits show the secret variant of The Sun or Temperance.

sections.title: How to get The Tower ending (Phantom Liberty)
sections.need: Phantom Liberty, and a choice in Firestarter that decides which of two routes you take.

steps.t: In [[Firestarter]], choose to help Songbird escape or to surrender her to Reed.
Near the end of [[The Killing Moon]], call Reed, or take So Mi to the shuttle.
When Reed appears, let him take her away.
Finish [[Through Pain to Heaven]].
Later, accept Reed's offer.

steps.h: If you surrendered her to Reed:

steps.t: Finish [[Black Steel In The Hour of Chaos]].
In [[Somewhat Damaged]], spare Songbird.
Finish [[Four Score and Seven]].
Later, accept Reed's offer.
Call Reed in [[Who Wants to Live Forever]] or on the rooftop in [[Nocturne Op55N1]].
Finish [[Things Done Changed]].

sections.check: The Tower achievement unlocks: V survives and starts a new life.

sections.title: How to get the Path of Least Resistance ending
sections.need: A save before the rooftop in Nocturne Op55N1. This ending kills V and has no rewards.

steps.t: On Misty's rooftop in [[Nocturne Op55N1]], choose the first dialogue option.
When Johnny asks if you are sure, choose "Could also just put all this to rest".
Choose "[Toss pills] I know exactly what we're gonna do."
Talk with Johnny until the scene moves to the view of Night City.

sections.check: A gunshot is heard and the credits roll; load your last save before the rooftop to play another ending.

choices._note: Choices that change what happens later. Each row cites the page it comes from.

rows.choice: Make the deal with Meredith Stout (Militech), or pay Maelstrom with your own cash
rows.effect: A deal with Meredith, with Maelstrom made hostile, is the only way to unlock Venus in Furs in Act 2; if Royce is killed, Brick will later retake control of Maelstrom

rows.choice: Where Jackie's body goes: to his family, to Viktor Vektor, or ask Delamain to wait
rows.effect: In Heroes: if V sent Jackie's body to his family or told Delamain to wait, Mama Welles asks V to join the ofrenda at El Coyote Cojo; if V sent Jackie's body to Viktor Vektor, Mama Welles sends a package with the key to Jackie's ARCH

rows.quest: With a Little Help from My Friends
rows.choice: Tell Saul about Panam's plan, or keep it to yourself
rows.effect: Telling Saul about Panam's plan will cause V and Panam's relationship to end, making Queen of the Highway and The Star ending unavailable
src: With a Little Help from My Friends

rows.effect: Not getting intimate with Judy during this mission makes it the last time she appears in the game, apart from the video message during the end credits

rows.choice: Answer "A hard road, but looks like we made it." then "Johnny, no need to bare your soul to me." (or the three secret-ending lines)
rows.effect: Starts Blistering Love (the quest for Rogue's ending); other options lead to Holdin' On. The Secret Ending dialogue options also start this quest, and V has to pick three specific dialogue options to get the secret ending
Needed for The Star ending (call Panam on the rooftop)
Unlocks The Sun ending with Rogue
Needed for The Devil achievement; if Takemura does not survive, there will be no support from Arasaka troops in that ending, and Oda will not show up
Oda can show up in The Devil ending (if Takemura is alive)
Mama Welles leaves a message during the credits that depends on your ending

rows.choice: Who you call on the rooftop (Hanako, Panam, Rogue, or wait for Johnny)
rows.effect: Picks the ending path; V's romantic interest may appear depending on who you choose to call

rows.choice: Side with Songbird or with Reed
rows.effect: By choosing Songbird's path, you are locked from the main course of action in the ending with Solomon Reed, and vice versa

rows.quest: Black Steel In The Hour of Chaos
rows.choice: Call Mr. Hands when you look for a netrunner and hire his netrunner; later accept Yoko Tsuru's deal and inform Hands about the MaxTac convoy
rows.effect: Sometime after finishing Leave in Silence, Hands will call V: he has left a gift in their apartment, the [[MaxTac Mantis Blades]]
King of Cups (fulfill) or King of Pentacles (refuse)

rows.choice: When Reed confronts you: kill him, or surrender So Mi to him
rows.effect: King of Wands (kill Reed) or King of Swords (surrender So Mi)
